Israeli soldiers’ cruel treatment of US citizen Omar Assad was inhumane—they abused him, then left him to die in the cold without medical attention.

I join Omar’s family, @SenBaldwin, and @RepGwenMoore in demanding an independent US investigation and Israeli accountability.

There’s power in a Union. From @Starbucks baristas, to @Amazon warehouse workers, to staffers in the halls of Congress, all workers deserve good pay, safe working conditions, fair treatment and a seat and voice at the table. #UnionsForAll #UnionStrong #1u

The labor movement is diverse and strong. @McDonalds workers in Chicago are standing up to demand fair treatment, and respect on the job. All workers deserve to be treated fairly, I support their right to seek union representation. When unions fight, workers win. #UnionsForAll

This isn’t a time to let our guard down as COVID cases are on the rise. Please make sure to take care of yourselves and your families. If you feel sick, stay home. If you have symptoms test. If you’re in crowded spaces, mask up. If you need a booster go to your closest pharmacy.

Evelyn and I are glad to hear that @POTUS is only experiencing mild symptoms, and wish him the best, and a quick and speedy recovery. It’s important to get vaccinated, boosted, and to test regularly if you are experiencing COVID-19 symptoms. Taking care of yourself is important.

Time to end the cruel Public Charge Rule imposed by Trump to intimidate immigrants. The new ruling makes it clear that the use of non-cash nutrition and health benefits, like SNAP and CHIP, will not affect one’s chances of becoming a lawful permanent resident or U.S. citizen.

In #Chicago, we respect  everyone's right to control their own bodies, and if you come here for an abortion, gender-affirming care, fertility treatment or birth control, you will be protected.

Today is a day to raise awareness on the impact of HIV on gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men.

And it's on all of us to prevent HIV stigma.

Stigma is a major obstacle to testing, treatment and preventative life saving medication like PrEP. https://t.co/FR0dTL0Dwf

Yesterday, the Fed raised interest rates for the 6th time this year. 

This rate hike, just like the last 5,  won’t address inflation’s root causes, like corporate greed.

It will hurt everyday people. The Fed must exercise caution before we have another recession.

Veterans deserve more than our thanks. They should have access to health care that is responsive to their needs, mental health care, and conflict-specific treatment.

I salute the veterans of IL-04 for their service, and will continue doing all I can in Congress in their support.

Did you know? Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, millions of Americans will save an average of $800 per year and $2,400 per family on #ACA health insurance premiums.

Ady Barkan was a courageous leader who did so much to advance the cause of healthcare justice. When Medicare for All becomes law, it will be in large part due to Ady’s advocacy and organizing.

Rest in power.

Across the globe, poor and minority communities are disproportionately impacted by the HIV/AIDS epidemic.

On #WorldAIDSDay, we raise awareness about the need to end HIV-related stigma as we continue our work to expand access to care and treatment and end this epidemic.
